project_info.theme: Mid-year mega sale poster with stacked Cocoon products
project_info.color_palette: Fresh Green Gradient, White, Dark Green, Amber Brown, Soft Pink, Golden Yellow

main_subject.detail: A sales poster with giant glowing number 66 in the background and a stack of Cocoon products in the foreground, including pomelo shampoo, winter melon micellar water, winter melon sunscreen fluid, An Giang sugar body polish, and a floating pink spray bottle.
main_subject.style: Retail sale key visual, dramatic product stacking, clean commercial poster with vibrant gradient background

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'SIÊU SALE GIỮA NĂM', giant '66', and a green circle reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 45%'.
items: Top Left: White headline 'SIÊU SALE GIỮA NĂM' on a green gradient backdrop.
Top Right: Huge translucent white number 66 and a floating pink spray bottle angled downward across the digits.
Bottom Left: Tall green pomelo shampoo bottle standing at the front edge of the arrangement.
Bottom Right: Stacked jars of winter melon sunscreen fluid and An Giang sugar body polish, with the micellar water bottle centered and elevated.
Center/Background: Green circular sale badge, black pedestal risers, and a luminous airbrushed gradient glow.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean glossy highlights, subtle pedestal shadows, bright promotional energy, soft radiant background glow

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a mid-year mega sale with stacked Cocoon products. Centerpiece is a clustered foreground arrangement of pomelo shampoo, winter melon micellar water, winter melon sunscreen fluid, An Giang sugar body polish, and a floating pink spray product, all set in front of a giant glowing '66'. Background is a fresh green gradient sales backdrop. Surrounding elements: white headline 'SIÊU SALE GIỮA NĂM', green circular badge 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 45%', and black pedestal risers beneath the products. Keep the exact sale-poster hierarchy, product label visibility, and luminous promotional mood. Technical style: high fidelity product-composite poster design, commercial sale poster lighting, glossy highlights and radiant gradient glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
